ten_questions.question: What items do users wishlist/save and why?
ten_questions.synthesis: Shoppers save footwear and ethnic wear to wishlists either to defer purchase decisions until discount events or when inspired by creator try-on videos.
verbatim_evidence: Saved these block heels for 2 months. Cushioning is decent... (pdp_rev_106)

ten_questions.question: Why do items sit in wishlists without purchase?
ten_questions.synthesis: Items stall in wishlists for weeks/months due to quality uncertainty (zip sticking) or photo color misrepresentation fears while waiting for a sale.
verbatim_evidence: Kept in wishlist for weeks, bought on price drop but zip quality gap. (pdp_rev_110)

ten_questions.question: Sizing/fit uncertainty vs. return fear
ten_questions.synthesis: Inconsistent brand size charts drive pre-purchase sizing inquiries asking creators for exact try-on height/bust/waist measurements.

ten_questions.question: Photo vs. reality quality/color doubts
ten_questions.synthesis: Shoppers hesitate in wishlists due to fear that studio photos hide thin translucent fabric or darker reality colors. Confidence: MEDIUM (Low Volume - 2 Records).
verbatim_evidence: Color in reality is much darker than shown in the app photos. Kept it in shortlist for a month... (pdp_rev_103)

ten_questions.question: Comparing shortlisted items / choice dilemma
ten_questions.synthesis: Shoppers post short title-only questions asking for help choosing between outfits for receptions/dates, but lack detailed behavioral elaboration in public comment text.
verbatim_evidence: Help me choose one dress for reception party (reddit_rss_t3_1k48pyu)

ten_questions.question: Info sought outside Myntra (reviews, social proof, trust)
ten_questions.synthesis: Shoppers research brand official website pricing vs Myntra and check platform cancellation fee increases before ordering.
verbatim_evidence: Why is Snitch's price and quality different on official website vs Flipkart/Myntra? (reddit_t3_1nywvf3)

ten_questions.question: Fit, size, styling, price, reviews & occasion suitability
ten_questions.synthesis: Multi-dimensional outfit selection evaluating occasion appropriateness (receptions, date nights, engagements), primarily in short title-only posts.
verbatim_evidence: Help Me Choose an Outfit for My Third Date! (reddit_rss_t3_1e64y2w)

ten_questions.question: Price vs value / discount waiting behavior
ten_questions.synthesis: Wishlists act as price-drop watchlists, holding items for weeks/months waiting for a sale discount.
verbatim_evidence: kept it in my wishlist for weeks waiting for a sale. (pdp_rev_101)

ten_questions.question: Behavioral differences across user segments
ten_questions.synthesis: Hypothesized Segment Archetypes: Segment patterns (Occasion-Driven Buyers, Fit-Sensitive Buyers, Brand-Conscious Buyers) are hypotheses derived from current evidence, NOT validated user segments. They require formal validation through Part 3 primary research.
verbatim_evidence: Help me choose what to wear for my very close friend's engagement! (reddit_rss_t3_1d82ls4)

ten_questions.question: Strategic product opportunity matrix
ten_questions.synthesis: Provides quantitative opportunity ranking connecting qualitative evidence to revenue metric linkage.
verbatim_evidence: Ranked Opportunity Scores: Peer Sizing (12.60), Occasion Choice Assistant (12.00), Price Transparency (4.80), Price Drop Activation (3.00), Photo Quality Guarantee (2.00).
